title: Kicked Double Fried Ukrainian Peas Pilaf
description: A light and cultured post-workout Ukrainian dish featuring frozen peas, double-fry KFC style, and FODMAP-friendly ingredients, served in a fondue pot.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the thawed frozen peas, garlic-infused oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the peas are tender.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a fondue pot and serve hot.
Double-fry the mixture by heating an additional 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat and pouring it over the top of the pilaf.
Serve the kicked double fried Ukrainian peas pilaf hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
